    offset:

    - 0.0
    - 0.0

    predicate: bilateral_grasp
    threshold: 0.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:

    strategy: repeat

  type: lift
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.2
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:

  parameters:

      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.3
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: object_lifted_check

    predicate: object_lifted
    threshold: 0.15

    entity: placement_surface

    - 0.0
    - 0.05
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    force_limit_approach:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 5.0
      - 20.0
      default: 15.0
      binds_to:
      - path: guards.approach_force.threshold
        mode: replace
    transport_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.5
      default: 0.2
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  guards:
  - id: approach_force
    when: during_phase
    predicate: force_below
    threshold: 15.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: offset_target
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: reach_place_standoff
- id: descend_goal
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: placement_surface
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
- id: release_object
  type: release
  control: position_control
  termination: time_limit
  end_effector_action: open
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
- id: retract_goal
